Title: Speedrun Zero: a GPT-2-class model for under $100
Hypothesis: At fixed compute, one architecture choice (GQA, NoPE, QK-norm, or vocab size) explains most of the gap between a budget GPT-2 reproduction and the reference

Title: TinyStories lab: the smallest model that can speak English
Hypothesis: Coherence emerges between roughly 4M and 10M parameters, and the threshold depends more on data repetition and tokenizer choice than on depth

Title: Textbook factory: synthetic data vs web data at 100M scale
Hypothesis: For a narrow domain, 1B tokens of synthetic textbook data beat 10B tokens of filtered web data at equal compute

Title: Professor and Student: on-policy distillation 7B to 0.5B
Hypothesis: On-policy reverse-KL distillation beats SFT on teacher traces by at least 5 points at 0.5B, per dollar spent

Title: The Quantization Frontier: how low can 3B go?
Hypothesis: A 3B model keeps at least 95% of its score at 4-bit, loses over 10% at 2-bit, and a recovery LoRA closes half the 2-bit gap

Title: Home-grown draft model: speculative decoding explained
Hypothesis: A 100M distilled draft yields at least 2x single-batch speedup at equal quality, mostly from acceptance rate

Title: Minimum Viable Reasoner: RLVR at 0.8-2B
Hypothesis: GRPO lifts a 0.8B model to over 50% on Countdown without SFT, but self-verification only emerges above a locatable scale threshold

Title: Distilling thought: how few examples teach reasoning?
Hypothesis: At 0.5B, 800 curated traces outperform 20K random traces on MATH500, and budget forcing adds 3-5 points

Title: Alignment bake-off: DPO vs KTO vs APO on 3B
Hypothesis: DPO, KTO, and APO reach similar win rates but differ in verbosity and refusal, and APO degrades least on scarce data

Title: Attention is not all you need: Transformer vs Mamba vs hybrid
Hypothesis: A 3:1 hybrid matches dense perplexity at 200M but is 2x faster at 32K context with retrieval parity

Title: Small MoE: eight experts, one GPU
Hypothesis: At iso-FLOPs, a 200M-total/50M-active top-2 MoE beats dense 50M by over 10% in loss

Title: 1.58 bits from scratch: BitNet at 100M
Hypothesis: A ternary 100M model matches fp16 within 2% perplexity and runs 2-3x faster on CPU at a quarter of the memory

Title: Pocket Agent: a 2B tool-caller on a phone
Hypothesis: A 2B model at 4-bit with speculative decoding serves a 3-tool workflow under 1 s/turn on a mid-range phone

Title: Specialist with receipts: a domain SLM that cites sources
Hypothesis: Fine-tuning beats RAG-only on accuracy, RAG-only wins on attribution, and the combination beats both

Title: Your language, your model: a multilingual SLM
Hypothesis: Continued pretraining on 2B tokens of Hindi/Marathi adds 8+ MILU points while losing under 2 English points

Title: The 2B agent: tool calling without a big model
Hypothesis: A 2B model lands within 5 BFCL points of an 8B model, and a confidence cascade beats either alone at half the cost

Title: Microscope: circuits in a 10M model
Hypothesis: A 10M TinyStories model contains induction heads and a monosemantic SAE feature whose ablation causally changes predictions

Title: SLM Olympics: a reproducible sub-4B benchmark
Hypothesis: A 5-task domain benchmark ranks sub-4B models differently from MMLU, and a 200-item subset reproduces the ranking

Title: Red-team: how fragile are small models?
Hypothesis: 0.5-2B models are more jailbreakable than 8B models, and a small safety SFT halves ASR at under 3% utility cost

Title: Voice-first tiny assistant
Hypothesis: A 1.5B audio model streams under 800 ms on a laptop and beats a cascaded ASR-LLM-TTS pipeline on short commands

Title: Diffusion vs autoregressive at 100M
Hypothesis: A 100M masked-diffusion LM matches AR quality at 2x training compute, decodes 4x faster in parallel, and infills far better
